title: Evidence desk
subtitle: Start with a question. Connect source excerpts, test a hypothesis, and record what the evidence can support.
question: Research question
questionPlaceholder: What do you want to establish?
hypothesisPlaceholder: A claim you can test against the literature
emptyEvidence: Add a paper, then record a source excerpt and page to support or challenge your hypothesis.
noPapers: Import papers into the library to start an evidence record.
conclusionPlaceholder: State the conclusion, uncertainty, and missing checks.
reviewHint: Opens an editable prompt. Review it before sending.
localOnly: Notebook creation requires a local desktop vault.
vaultChanged: The vault changed. Reopen the evidence desk before saving.
draftHint: Drafts stay in this window and are separated by vault. Create a notebook before quitting; each creation saves a new file.
incomplete: Fill in an excerpt and a positive PDF page number.
recorded: Excerpts are user-recorded; they have not been automatically verified.
